deck_title: Enterprise Interactive Shoppable & Branching Video Player Studio: Offline SAM-2/ByteTrack Spline JSON + 60fps Live ERP DOM Hotspots + MSE <15ms Zero-Black-Frame Branching (c_shop = c_0/(1+u), 1.0000x Lock) vs Naive Baked Pixel Tags & Buffering Stalls

cards.subtitle: Deterministic Enterprise Interactive Shoppable & Branching Video evaluation (extracting multi-SKU cubic-spline trajectory tracks [14KB WebVTT/JSON] and occlusion masks offline via SAM-2 + ByteTrack, synchronizing 60fps DOM/SVG callout pills via requestVideoFrameCallback with live Shopify/ERP GraphQL pricing and out-of-stock suppression, and pre-buffering child story branches in dual MSE SourceBuffers for <15ms zero-black-frame transitions so amortized cost c_shop(u) = c_0 / (1 + u) reaches 0.5000 at u = 1.0, locking C_active / C_shop = 1.0000x across all 17 stages u in [0.000, 1.000] with 0/17 violated) versus naive burned-in MP4 price tags and direct video.src reloads (which cause 2.1s black buffering stalls and force full video re-encoding on every price/stock change, inflating cost by 1 + u to 1.2500x at S4, 1.5000x at S8, and 2.0000x at S16 across 16/17 stages) and 64-frame spline quadrature.

cards.headline: Exact controls are useful; realism remains a separate job.
good_fit: Brand flagship e-commerce sites (Shopify / Headless Commerce), interactive fashion runway lookbooks, and branching product-finder videos
Baking offline SAM-2 + ByteTrack object trajectories into a 14KB cubic-spline JSON sidecar rendered at 60fps via requestVideoFrameCallback + live ERP GraphQL inventory
Pre-fetching child branch Closed-GOP segments in dual MSE SourceBuffers for <15ms zero-black-frame story transitions
not_for: Burning static price tags and SKU names directly into MP4 video pixels where viewers cannot click them and price changes invalidate the video
Switching interactive story branches by reassigning `<video src="...">` (causes 1.5–2.5s black buffering spinner and 62% viewer drop-off)
